Pehli baar Gulf mein job ka plan hai? Yeh 5 tips pehle padh lo. 📌

1️⃣ CV short aur clear rakho — har application se pehle update karo.
2️⃣ Har job offer verify karo. Koi job ke naam pe paise maange toh savdhaan rahiye.
3️⃣ Documents ready rakho — passport, degree, marksheets, experience letters, aur sabki digital copies.
4️⃣ Seekhte raho — achhi English, thodi Arabic, aur koi naya skill ya certificate.
5️⃣ Akele shuru mat karo — wahan pehle se rehne wale Kokanis se baat karo, sawaal poocho.
